title: Lesson 1: The for loop
lessonSummary: Great! With for and range() you repeat code as often as you like.

tasks.instruction: Run this example and see how often the loop runs.
tasks.codeTemplate:
for i in range(5):
    print(f"Lap {i+1}: The horse trots elegantly")

tasks.instruction: Use a for loop with range(3) to print exactly the word Hoofbeat three times (each on its own line).
Use range(4) and i+1 to print exactly these lines: Lap 1, Lap 2, Lap 3, Lap 4

title: Lesson 2: range() with start and end
lessonSummary: You decide where the numbers start and where they stop!

tasks.instruction: Run this example. Notice which hurdle comes last.
tasks.codeTemplate:

title: Lesson 3: Step size and counting backwards
lessonSummary: Skip hurdles or count backwards – with the third range() value!

tasks.instruction: Run this example: a countdown to the start of the tournament.

Print the odd lane numbers 1 to 9, each exactly like this: Lane 1, Lane 3, Lane 5, Lane 7, Lane 9 (step size 2).

title: Lesson 4: Loops over text
lessonSummary: Text can be walked through letter by letter, too!

tasks.instruction: Run this example and look at the individual letters.
tasks.codeTemplate:
name = "Thunder"
print(f"The horse's name is: {name}")
for letter in name:
    print(f"  - {letter}")

tasks.instruction: Go through the name and print each letter exactly like this: - L, - u, - n, - a (each on its own line).
Count how often the letter n appears in the name (with a loop and an if) and print exactly: Count n: 2

title: Lesson 5: The while loop
lessonSummary: As long as the condition is true, the while loop keeps going!

tasks.instruction: Run this example: counting up to 5.
Use a while loop to print the lines Lap 1 to Lap 4 (the counter starts at 1).
Add up the numbers 1 to 5 with a while loop in the variable total and print exactly: Total: 15

title: Lesson 6: while with conditions
lessonSummary: The loop runs until the horse is exhausted – the condition decides!

tasks.instruction: Run this example and watch when the training ends.
tasks.codeTemplate:
stamina = 100
lap = 1
while stamina > 20:
    stamina -= 15
    print(f"Lap {lap}: {stamina}% left")
    lap += 1
print(f"Training finished after {lap-1} laps!")
